publicationDecision.scope: Update the existing survodutide programme after complete review of the sponsor's 5 October SYNCHRONIZE-JP announcement and the exact sponsor-submitted registry lifecycle. Editorial authorisation is not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

fields.stage: Phase 3 obesity, MASH and type 2 diabetes programmes; Japanese Phase 3 sponsor results reported
fields.summaryToAppend: Boehringer Ingelheim's 5 October 2026 Japanese announcement reports SYNCHRONIZE-JP results after 76 weeks in 274 participants. It reports mean body-weight changes of -12.5% with 3.6 mg and -13.1% with 6.0 mg versus -1.6% with placebo. In a separate MRI-assessed subset it also reports reductions in visceral and liver fat. The sponsor-submitted NCT06176365 record is completed after an actual 16 January 2024 start and 3 December 2025 completion, but has no registry-posted results.
fields.limitationsToAppend: These are sponsor-reported conference results, not ClinicalTrials.gov-posted outcomes or a reviewed full results paper. The MRI findings concern a subset and must not be generalized to every participant; changes in fat measures do not establish muscle strength, function or a muscle-preservation benefit. The Japanese population and local obesity-disease criteria must not be treated as a UK indication. Completed research and reported group averages do not establish individual benefit, UK marketing authorisation, NICE or NHS access, UK supply, an approved dose or clinical approval.

sourceReviews.outcome: Original Japanese sponsor announcement read for the completed 76-week Phase III comparison, reported body-weight findings, MRI-subset visceral- and liver-fat findings and gastrointestinal adverse-event summary. It does not establish UK authorisation, access, supply, individual benefit or clinical approval.
Complete primary API body read: completed Phase III; 274 actual participants; actual 16 January 2024 start and 3 December 2025 primary completion/completion; no registry-posted results.

configuredSourcePass.boundary: The SELECT-only public response verifies configured-source monitoring only. It does not renew factual reviews, approve changed wording or prove complete industry coverage. The Zealand 403 remains explicit.

discoveryPass.method: A separate configured-source pass checked availability, changes, withdrawals, overdue reviews and monitor failures. Current-date and undated topic searches then covered weight-management medicines, peptides, combinations, muscle-preservation claims, specialist indications, early and late trials, pauses and discontinuations across named and additional developers.
discoveryPass.included: The existing survodutide programme did not contain SYNCHRONIZE-JP or NCT06176365. The 5 October sponsor result changes the evidence summary and the complete registry lifecycle supports one new monitored record without adding a duplicate programme.
discoveryPass.notDuplicated: PR #851 and subsequent dated Watch receipts were inspected. No open Watch review pull request contains this Japanese result or registry record.
incompleteChecks: Search indexing can lag and selected searches cannot exclude older omissions, unannounced programmes or additional international developers.

No new MHRA authorisation, NICE recommendation, NHS access decision or verified UK supply change was established.
